scope: New DeltaLog explicit-opt-in observer-free production-path experiment, not a modification of frozen R21/continuous numerical gates
motivation: Independent full-pool comparisons are correctness instrumentation, not mandatory permanent per-token production work. Removing them without validating the resulting exact path is forbidden; retaining multi-GiB D2H/token in an alleged fast service also cannot establish the intended deployment benefit.
requirements: Keep all original full-byte numerical and inactive-pool results, including FAIL; no changed thresholds, missing domains or paper-wide negative inference.

Develop a distinct default-OFF explicit mode. Bind exact plugin source, installed operator DSOs/binaries/schema, model/layer/shared-pool geometry, dtype/strides/format and strong request/generation/committed-slot domain.

Before performance admission, actually execute the new mode on NPU against the already instrumented implementation/native-independent references, comparing output and complete pool/state, inactive bytes, multiple steps and relevant request retirement/slot reuse; eager-only remains explicit unless graph also validated.
Use external independent observation around the new path during qualification; do not silently replace the production algorithm with the instrumented old path and call that new-mode coverage.

Verify unchanged mathematical dispatch/core/operator code and state ownership semantics. Register any source/instrumentation difference; mismatching input/domain/layout/library identity rejects promotion.

After actual matching evidence, retain runtime identity/metadata/slot-bound/ownership guards. Benchmark no profiling/large tensor capture on both dense and candidate, same common optimizations/input/concurrency/1024 output.

Do not turn a diagnostic qualified:false into production:true, merely disable a failing guard, reuse old106 arena false predicates, invent certificates, or substitute software fixtures for real NPU evidence.
